article.story: BOCA RATON, Fla. -- — Yaxel Lendeborg scored 22 points on Sunday night to help UAB beat Florida Atlantic 81-76. Lendenborg made 10 of 13 from the field and added 10 rebounds and seven assists for UAB (10-7, 3-1 American Athletic Conference). Christian Coleman made 6 of 10 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. Alejandro Vasquez hit 4 of 12 from the field and made 6 of 7 from the foul line to added 14 points. Tre Carroll led Florida Atlantic (9-8, 2-2) with 20 points. KyKy Tandy hit four 3-pointers and finished with 14 points and Kaleb Glenn scored 13 with eight rebounds. Baba Miller scored 10 points and blocked three shots. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
